description: Galbi, or Korean BBQ Short Ribs, features tender beef marinated in a sweet and savory soy-garlic sauce, then grilled to perfection. This iconic dish is a staple of Korean cuisine, known for its rich flavor and satisfying texture. Prepare to impress your family and friends with this authentic and delicious homemade recipe.

instructions.title: Prepare the Short Ribs
instructions.text: Rinse the short ribs thoroughly under cold water to remove any bone fragments and excess blood. Pat them completely dry with paper towels. If your ribs are very thick, you can lightly score them against the grain on both sides to help with tenderness and marinade absorption.

instructions.title: Make the Marinade
instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, minced garlic, grated fresh ginger, grated Asian pear, grated onion, water, and black pepper. Whisk all ingredients together until the brown sugar is fully dissolved and the marinade is well combined. The grated fruit and onion add natural sweetness and act as a tenderizer.

instructions.title: Marinate the Ribs
instructions.text: Place the prepared short ribs into the marinade, ensuring each piece is fully coated. You can use a large bowl or a resealable plastic bag. Cover the bowl or seal the bag and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or ideally overnight, for the best flavor and tenderness. Marinating for up to 24 hours is recommended.

instructions.title: Preheat Grill or Pan
instructions.text: Preheat your outdoor grill to medium-high heat. If using a stovetop, heat a cast iron grill pan or heavy-bottomed skillet over medium-high heat. Lightly brush the grill grates or pan with a little oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: Grill the Short Ribs
instructions.text: Remove the ribs from the marinade, letting any excess drip off. Do not wipe off the marinade. Place the ribs on the hot grill or pan. Grill for 3-5 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until they are beautifully caramelized, slightly charred, and cooked through to your desired doneness. Turn frequently to ensure even cooking and prevent burning.

instructions.title: Rest and Garnish
instructions.text: Once cooked, transfer the Galbi to a cutting board or platter and let them rest for a few minutes. This helps the juices redistribute, ensuring tender and juicy ribs. Garnish generously with chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds before serving hot.

tips: For authentic Galbi tenderness, using an Asian pear in the marinade is crucial as its enzymes naturally tenderize the meat. If unavailable, a small amount of kiwi or pineapple can be used as a substitute, but be cautious as they are more potent.
Always rinse your short ribs thoroughly before marinating. This removes bone fragments and any impurities, leading to a cleaner flavor profile. Patting them dry ensures the marinade adheres better.

Galbi is best served immediately off the grill with a side of steamed rice, kimchi, and various banchan (small Korean side dishes) for a complete Korean BBQ experience. Leftovers can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
